s:
It was almost five in the afternoon when Mr. Tarek rushed into the ER carrying his nephew Omar, a skinny nine-year-old with a towel pressed to his left arm. Omar had crashed his bicycle into broken glass outside the bakery. By the time they arrived the bleeding had stopped, but the towel was soaked and Omar was pale and crying.

Nurse Salma checked him quickly. His heart was racing at 112, but his blood pressure was fine and he was talking clearly, so she put him in the yellow area. Omar weighed 28 kg, had no allergies his uncle knew of, and had his last tetanus shot at six.

Dr. Hany unwrapped the towel and found a clean 5 cm cut on the inside of the forearm. Omar could move every finger. "We'll need stitches," Dr. Hany said. Mr. Tarek nodded. "His parents are at work, but go ahead, I'm responsible for him." Dr. Hany washed the wound, numbed it with lidocaine and closed it with six neat stitches. He gave Omar 420 mg of paracetamol for the pain and sent him home with his uncle and a wound-care leaflet.
h: "His parents are at work, but go ahead, I'm responsible for him."

a.o: Dr. Hany stitched Omar's arm after only his uncle agreed, when his parents were a phone call away.
a.x: Dr. Hany should have phoned Omar's parents for consent before stitching.
a.w: An uncle is not Omar's legal guardian. The bleeding had stopped, so this was not an emergency and there was time to reach a parent.

a.o: Nurse Salma sent Omar to the yellow area, when a child cut by glass with a racing heart should be seen first.
a.x: Omar should have gone straight to the red area.
a.w: Yellow was right: the bleeding had stopped, his blood pressure was normal and he was talking. A fast heart in a scared, crying child is not shock.

a.o: Dr. Hany gave Omar 420 mg of paracetamol, far too much for a 28 kg boy.
a.x: Omar should have had 280 mg of paracetamol.
a.w: 420 mg is 15 mg/kg for a 28 kg child, a normal dose.

a.o: Omar went home without a tetanus shot after falling on dirty glass.
a.x: Omar should have had a tetanus booster before leaving.
a.w: His last tetanus shot was three years ago. A dirty wound needs a booster only if the last one was more than 5 years ago.
